title: A Least-Squares Weak Galerkin Method for Second-Order Elliptic Equations in Non-Divergence Form
summary: This article proposes a novel least-squares weak Galerkin (LS-WG) method for second-order elliptic equations in non-divergence form. The approach leverages a locally defined discrete weak Hessian operator constructed within the weak Galerkin framework. A key feature of the resulting algorithm is that it yields a symmetric and positive definite linear system while remaining applicable to general polygonal and polyhedral meshes.
